source: Official Binance USD-M daily BTCUSDT bookTicker and aggTrades archives
timestamp_integrity_amendment: Added before accepting results after raw 2024-02-15 inspection revealed alternating future-timestamp rows: while streaming BBO, reject rows that move backward or jump more than 60 seconds beyond the last accepted event. BTCUSDT BBO is continuously active; rejected counts are reported and raw archives remain unchanged.

dates.rule: latest eight available monthly 15th bookTicker dates ending 2024-03-15; amended before results after the official 2024-04-15 archive returned 404

hypothetical_fill.bid: sell-initiated aggregate trade price at or below the most recent BBO bid whose event timestamp is no later than the trade timestamp
hypothetical_fill.ask: buy-initiated aggregate trade price at or above the most recent BBO ask under the same timing rule
hypothetical_fill.deduplication: at most one observation per aggregate trade
hypothetical_fill.aggregation: one equal-weight observation per 10-second bin having at least one touch-qualified fill; the target is mean fill markout in that bin
hypothetical_fill.claim_limit: touch-qualified hypothetical fill only; no queue position, fill probability, fee, rebate, or latency claim

outcomes.primary: signed passive markout in bps from quoted fill price to BBO midpoint 10 seconds later

state.conventional: spread, displayed BBO depth, imbalance, recent midpoint volatility and signed trade flow
state.breakdown: local depth minimum/change, BBO update concentration, burst rate, opposing flow and model disagreement
state.critical_score: nonlinear conventional-model predicted markout minus breakdown-model predicted markout, so higher values mean the breakdown model expects worse passive performance
state.critical_threshold: validation-fixed bottom and top quintiles of critical score

primary_gate: holdout high-minus-low breakdown-state 10-second passive markout is negative with a date-cluster bootstrap 95% interval strictly below zero
breakdown model improves holdout MAE over a nonlinear conventional-feature control by at least 5%
both holdout dates have directionally negative high-minus-low markout
interpretation: A pass would support state-dependent adverse selection under conservative touch qualification, not establish achievable market-making PnL. A failure rejects only this BBO proxy implementation.
